summary.value: Zinc Bar is a historic Greenwich Village bar and jazz club at 82 W 3rd Street, the former Cinderella Club where Billie Holiday performed, with late hours and live music nightly. Restaurantji diners fell for the romantic Art-Deco-era Paris jazz bar vibe, and one couple returned a year later to propose there. It suits a late, music-first night out.

claims.text: the romantic Art-Deco-era Paris jazz bar vibe

description.value: Zinc Bar is a historic bar and jazz club in Greenwich Village. It occupies the famous space at 82 W 3rd street once known as the Cinderella Club where Billie Holiday performed. Posted hours run late, with Friday 5 pm - 2 am, so it suits a late night. Restaurantji shows 4.1 300 ratings. Representative Restaurantji praise (diner reviews): “We immediately fell in love with the romantic Art-Deco-era Paris jazz bar vibe”; “Really friendly staff and good cocktails”. Representative watch-outs: “I wish they had different snacks for the folks who can't/don't want flat bread”; “Get there early for your choice of seat”.

review1: Zinc Bar wins guests over with a romantic, Art Deco Paris-style jazz bar atmosphere that some couples find unforgettable.
review2: Friendly bar staff and good cocktails are recurring praise and a big part of the enjoyable evenings guests describe.
review3: Music and atmosphere are strong, but seating fills up, so guests recommend arriving early for a good spot.
review4: The food menu is limited, with guests wishing for more than flatbread, so it is best to eat dinner before the set.
